description: This file defines the MTurkClient class in the AWS SDK for PHP, providing an interface to interact with the Amazon Mechanical Turk Requester Service. It contains method annotations for various operations available in the service, indicating methods for synchronous and asynchronous API calls.

classes.name: MTurkClient
classes.description: A client class to interact with the Amazon Mechanical Turk Requester Service, extending the base AWS client.

methods.name: acceptQualificationRequest
methods.description: Accepts a qualification request from a Worker.

methods.name: associateQualificationWithWorker
methods.description: Associates a Qualification with a Worker.

methods.name: createHIT
methods.description: Creates a new Human Intelligence Task (HIT).
